subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hit the nail on the head

options.text: They have accurately identified or explained something.
They hit a nail with a hammer.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Hit the nail on the head"** means to accurately identify or explain something. (किसी चीज़ को सही ढंग से पहचानना या समझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **When she said that the team's success was due to their hard work, she really hit the nail on the head.
 
 
 
• **"Accurately identified or explained something" ** refers to someone understanding or pinpointing the exact cause or essence of a situation. (सही ढंग से पहचानना या समझाना)
 
 
• **Example: **His analysis of the financial crisis hit the nail on the head.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: They are experiencing a headache** (उन्हें सिरदर्द हो रहा है)

 
 
• **Example:** Due to the loud noise, they are experiencing a headache.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: They're uncertain about a decision** (वे एक निर्णय के बारे में अनिश्चित हैं)
 
 
• **Example: **He is uncertain about a decision regarding his career change.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: They hit a nail with a hammer** (उन्होंने एक कील को हथौड़े से मारा)
 
 
• **Example:** While fixing the chair, they hit a nail with a hammer.
 
 

3a:Tb49,
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **ACEBD**
